summary: Spec Ledger makes automated coding trustworthy: agents implement from sealed context, and humans can see how the product evolved and why — so changing X cannot silently break Y.
northStar: A verify verdict is a pure function of ledger + tree + results; episodes and compass never invent pass. Quality bar: library/staging first, correctness-critical digests, cheap next change over clever now.
users: humans reviewing agent work in Lattice
coding agents that must not invent pass
